fieldValues.title: One essay view plugs into both websites
fieldValues.move: Make the essay's reader view one piece that the muDemocracy and semanticops websites both plug in, so a published essay is drawn from its records with its sources available and says how it was made.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Comments and working material in a shared file (the later cleaner, 0d1c7493). A reader's agent connecting from a link (SP-152). Evidence that anyone uses the editor (SP-153): a reader of our site is not yet a user of the editor.
fieldValues.falsifier: A published essay differs from its records after the next build, a reader cannot open a quote's source from the page, or the two sites end up with separate essay views.
source_ref: muDemocracy.org: scripts/ensure-srs-web.mjs and export-srs-pages.mjs already run srs-web's site core at build time, a possible starting point (not assessed)
muSrs/packages/essay/compositions: the essay composition is tagged reader, and essay-references renders what it refers to
fieldValues.return_when: The theory of change has gone from the editor to both sites this way and the owner has said whether it presents the stack.
